senses.gloss:
Sthiraka Gārgya (‘descendant of garga’) is the name of a teacher in the vaṃśa brāhmaṇa.
Foot notes Indische Studien, 4, 373.

Sthivi occurs once (used in the plural) in the Rigveda, probably meaning ‘bushel.’ The word is also found once in the adjective sthivimant, ‘provided with bushels.’
Foot notes x. 68, 3.
Rv. x. 27, 15. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 238.
